agent_explanation: With no walls, no touching pairs, controller disabled (force 0, work 0), total energy rises monotonically: 3073.9 -> 3167.28 -> 3281.91 -> 3417.80. Per-step speed change is ~1.485 m/s while g*dt is only ~0.2475 m/s (6x too large), so gravity integration over-accelerates bodies and injects net mechanical energy each step until energy_bound is violated at step 3.
